text_block_list.text:
I saw Air Groove looking dejected
in the plaza and called out to her, but――

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...This has nothing to do with you.
There is no need for you to pry.
choice_data_list: Aren't you feeling under the weather?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You don't need to worry that much.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's just that I let the flower wither through my own carelessness.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
How careless of me...
Could I really have let my guard down...?
For a while after that, she remained in poor shape.
